title: The first evening
text: The key turns twice before the door gives way. Inside, the house smells of fresh paint and nothing else. Your footsteps echo in the kitchen, where one bare bulb hangs over the spot a table might stand one day. You put the first thing down, step back and look at it. It is small and a little crooked, and it is yours. Somewhere outside a neighbour's radio plays. For the first time, the empty rooms sound less like silence and more like a beginning.
